answer: Every agent ties its identity to one carrier-verified phone number, listed once in the Onyx registry. The agent requests an SMS code, enters it, and the registry checks with the carrier that the line is a real mobile number, not VoIP. One number anchors one agent, and each month the registry sends a fresh code to answer within 48 hours; a silent number loses its seat. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake agents must buy a meadow of real SIM cards at $5 each, $5,000 up front, plus $2 a month per line, and hours of handling per card. A real agent pays $5 once.
